Replace with real consented photos or remove the field to fall back to initials avatars. `slug` lets a page exclude whoever it already features as a case study or pull quote, so the same story is never told twice on one page.

list.name: Priya Nandakumar
list.quote: I'd sent out forty applications with nothing back. My recruiter had me in front of a hiring manager within two weeks — and the role fit better than anything I'd found on my own.

list.name: Marcus Devereux
list.quote: We stopped sifting through hundreds of resumes. Every candidate they send has already been screened for the role we actually described, not a generic version of it.

list.name: Sofia Reyes
list.quote: The interview coaching alone was worth it. I walked in knowing exactly what they'd ask and why — and I had an offer four days later.

list.name: James Okafor
list.quote: I came in through the IT Training track with no industry experience. Six weeks after certification, I had a placement lined up.

list.name: Aisha Karim
list.quote: They talked me out of two roles I'd have taken in a heartbeat. Both were wrong for me, and they knew it before I did. That's when I understood what I'd actually hired them for.

list.name: Daniel Osei
list.quote: Nine months in and my recruiter still checks in. I didn't expect the relationship to outlast the placement, but it has.

list.name: Lena Toma
list.quote: I was switching fields at thirty-four and every recruiter treated that as a problem to explain away. These ones treated it as the story.

list.name: Omar Haddad
list.quote: Time-to-fill went from eleven weeks to under four. The difference is they actually read the brief instead of keyword-matching it.
